name: The Unlabeled Drawer
description: Infer the hidden visual filing rule with four calibration tests, then classify all six sealed final specimens.
natural_language: Infer the drawer's rule using at most four calibration tests, then classify all six final specimens. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL edits, reload, navigation, extensions, external applications, or unrelated tabs.

metadata.source_notes: Wisconsin Card Sorting contributes feedback-driven discovery of an unstated rule; Bongard-LOGO contributes procedural visual concepts, contextual comparison, and nuisance variation. The cabinet, specimens, interaction, and rule families are original.
metadata.notes: Every generated bank has an outcome-independent visible contrast plan whose every nonempty response branch determines the final tray across the full advertised rule family. The archive exposes one tested specimen and outcome at a time, and the final tray exposes one unprobeable specimen at a time. Browser, server, and verifier bind the selected interaction surface and independently replay probe choice, final order, and both drag endpoints.
